text: My daily routine is built on consistency. I wake up at six each morning, starting with a quick glass of water and ten minutes of stretching. After breakfast, I leave for work at eight. My schedule is steady: I handle emails before noon, then focus on projects during the afternoon. Exercise happens right after work—I either jog in the park or do a short yoga session at home. Evenings are for cooking a simple meal, reading a chapter of a book, or calling my family. By ten, I’m in bed, ready to repeat it all. This predictability keeps me calm and productive.
